analysis.steps.title: Steps
analysis.steps.lead: Steps work on the results of the queries, one after the other. The queries themselves stay as they are.
analysis.steps.status.notRun: Not run, an earlier step failed
analysis.steps.status.noData: Run the query to see what this step makes.
analysis.preview.none: There is nothing to show yet.
analysis.toFrame.columns: Columns from the documents of query {frame}: {columns}. You choose them in the query’s editor.
analysis.field.name: Name of the new field
analysis.field.expressionHelp: Fields by name, or in brackets when the name has spaces or symbols: [Revenue (€)] * 1.19. Functions: {functions}
analysis.mode.inner: Only rows found on both sides
analysis.mode.left: All rows of the left query
analysis.trend.fitted: Trend line as a new field
analysis.compare.hint: The query has to cover both periods; for a week, choose at least the last 14 days.
analysis.about.sort: Orders the rows by one or more fields; empty cells last.
analysis.export.title: Export data
analysis.export.format.csv: CSV, for Excel and other spreadsheets
analysis.export.format.graphml: GraphML, for Gephi, yEd and Cytoscape
analysis.export.format.csvNodes: CSV of the nodes, one column per property
analysis.export.format.csvEdges: CSV of the edges, with source, target and type
analysis.export.tableStepHint: Add a step that makes a table of it first.
analysis.export.hintShape: The file holds the result after all active steps, in its own shape. To export it as a table, add a step that makes a table of it first.
analysis.export.hint: The file holds the result after all active steps. Times are in UTC.
analysis.export.stored: The saved panel is exported; save the dashboard first to export your changes.
analysis.catalog.tablesLater: Table steps follow a step that makes a table.
analysis.about.calculate: A new field from an expression over the fields.
analysis.about.join: Joins the table of another query by time or by key fields.
analysis.about.reduce: Sum, mean, percentiles and more per field.
analysis.about.trend: The least-squares line of a field.
analysis.about.movingAverage: The mean over the last rows, as a new field.
analysis.about.correlate: How closely two fields move together.
analysis.about.compare: Each value next to the one a period earlier.
analysis.about.group: One row per value of the chosen fields, with summaries.
analysis.about.pivot: Values of a field as columns.
analysis.about.toFrame: Nodes or edges with chosen properties as rows.
analysis.about.countLabels: Nodes per label, with their share.
analysis.about.countEdgeTypes: Edges per type, with the labels of their ends.
analysis.about.degreeDistribution: How many nodes have how many edges.
analysis.about.topDegree: The N most connected nodes with the edges between them.
analysis.about.sharedNeighbours: Pairs of nodes with the most neighbours in common, such as customers who bought the same products.
analysis.graph.label: Label
analysis.graph.fields.countLabels: New fields: label, nodes (number), share (0 to 1).
analysis.graph.fields.countEdgeTypes: New fields: type, from and to (the labels of the ends), edges (number).
analysis.graph.fields.degreeDistribution: New fields: degree, nodes (both numbers). A loop counts twice.
analysis.graph.fields.topDegree: Stays a graph; the edges between the N nodes stay.
analysis.graph.fields.sharedNeighbours: New fields: a, b, shared (number), neighbours (list).
analysis.graph.fields.toFrame: Lists stay lists. After this step all table steps are open.
analysis.chain.title: Shapes of the steps
analysis.about.degree: Edges per node as a new property, by direction, edge type and weight.
analysis.about.filterGraph: Nodes by label or property, edges by type; stays a graph.
analysis.graph.fields.degree: Stays a graph; each node gets its degree. A loop counts twice.
analysis.graph.fields.filterGraph: Stays a graph; edges stay where both ends stay. Nothing chosen keeps everything.
analysis.about.filterSpans: By service, operation, attribute, status or duration.
analysis.about.criticalPath: Only the spans that decide the total duration.
analysis.about.spanTable: One row per span, attributes as columns.
analysis.about.traceTable: One row per trace: first span, duration, spans, errors.
analysis.about.serviceMap: Services as nodes, calls as edges with count, errors and duration.
analysis.about.spanTree: Every span a node, an edge from its parent.
analysis.summary.centralitySame: {nodes} nodes scored. All nodes have the same value.
analysis.summary.communities: {count} communities, modularity {modularity}. The largest has {largest} nodes.
analysis.summary.communitiesOne: 1 community: the graph could not be split in a useful way.
analysis.summary.components: {count} components. The largest has {largest} of {nodes} nodes.
analysis.summary.kCoreOf: {nodes} of {of} nodes are in the core with k = {k}. Largest core number: {maxCore}.
analysis.summary.linkPredictionNone: No suggestions: no pair without an edge has neighbours in common.
analysis.summary.paths: {paths} paths, the first with {edges} edges from {from} to {to}.
analysis.summary.noPathWithin: No path within {maxLength} edges; the shortest has {edges}.
analysis.summary.reachable: {nodes} of {of} other nodes can be reached in {maxHops} steps.
analysis.summary.bridgesNone: No bridges: every edge has a way around it.
analysis.summary.cyclesCut: {count} of at least {count} cycles. Reason: at most {maxCount}.
analysis.summary.aggregateAlong: {nodes} of {of} nodes now have {name}. Highest value: {top} ({max}).
analysis.summary.aggregateAlongPaths: {paths} of {of} paths now have {name}. Smallest: {min}, largest: {max}.
analysis.place.algorithm.no_library: Computed on the server: the database has no library for this step.
analysis.place.algorithm.local: Computed on the server: the step needs only the result.
analysis.place.algorithm.not_in_library: Computed on the server: the database’s library has no variant of this step for a part of the graph.
analysis.place.algorithm.enumerating: Computed on the server: listing steps keep their count and length limits there.
analysis.place.algorithm.not_cancellable: Always computed on the server: the database cannot stop a running procedure.
analysis.place.algorithm.option: Computed on the server: the database’s library does not offer a chosen setting.
analysis.place.algorithm.isolated_nodes: Computed on the server: nodes without edges are missing from the database’s projection.
analysis.place.algorithm.empty: Computed on the server: the result has no edges.
analysis.place.algorithm.library_failed: Computed on the server: the database’s library did not answer. The result is the same.
analysis.place.algorithm.place_server: Computed on the server, as set on the step.
analysis.place.algorithm.answer_unreadab: The database answered the step in an unexpected form. Kalzit does not guess a result.
analysis.about.filterFields: Keep only the fields that match.
analysis.about.convert: Text to number, time or true or false.
analysis.about.filterRows: By values: equal, greater, matches, is empty.
analysis.about.stack: Tables with the same fields as one.
analysis.about.seriesToRows: One row per time and series.
analysis.about.reduceSeries: Each series to one value: last, sum and more.
analysis.help.organize: Puts fields in an order, gives them readable names and hides what nobody needs. Changes no values.
analysis.help.filterFields: Keeps or leaves out fields by their name: names you pick, a regular expression, or both. Changes no values.
analysis.help.convert: Turns a field into another type in its place: text into numbers, times or true and false, numbers or times into text. Values that cannot be read become empty.
analysis.help.filterRows: Keeps or leaves out rows by their values. All conditions must hold, or one is enough. An empty value equals nothing.
analysis.help.limit: Keeps only the first or the last rows, such as the ten largest after sorting.
analysis.help.stack: Puts the rows of several queries one under the other. Fields with the same name become one field; a field one table lacks stays empty there.
analysis.help.seriesToRows: Turns series into a long table: one row per time and series with time, metric and value. Handy for tables and for grouping by series.
analysis.help.reduceSeries: Brings every series to one value per calculation, such as the last value or the sum: one row per series, or one row with a field per series.
analysis.keywords.convert: data type, cast, parse, date, number
analysis.catalog.searchHint: Find a step: name, keyword or what you want to do
analysis.catalog.before.frame: The result before this step is a table: {rows} rows, {fields} fields
analysis.catalog.before.graph: The result before this step is a graph: {nodes} nodes, {edges} edges
analysis.catalog.before.trace: The result before this step is a trace: {count} spans
analysis.catalog.before.none: Run the query to see your data here.
analysis.catalog.reason.name: Match in the name
analysis.catalog.previewNote: The preview takes the first rows of your result.
analysis.catalog.previewNoData: Run the query to try this step on your data.
analysis.catalog.previewLater: This step runs where the query runs; its result shows once it is added.
analysis.catalog.doesNotFit: Does not fit your data yet: {reason}
analysis.organize.hint: A field the query adds later comes last and is shown.
analysis.organize.noFields: Run the query to arrange its fields.
analysis.filterFields.patternHelp: Found anywhere in the first 150 characters of the name: ^cpu finds names that start with cpu. At most two repeats such as * or + (a leading or trailing .* is free), no repeated group with |, such as (a|b)+.
analysis.filterRows.matchesHelp: A pattern is found anywhere in the first 150 characters of the value. At most two repeats such as * or + (a leading or trailing .* is free), no repeated group with |, such as (a|b)+.
analysis.convert.formatHelp: Without a format, ISO 8601 such as 2026-01-31T08:15. Parts: YYYY, MM, DD, HH, mm, ss, SSS, such as DD.MM.YYYY HH:mm.
analysis.reduceMode.columns: One row, a field per series
analysis.reduce.fieldsHint: Without a choice, every number field.
analysis.combine.needsTwo: Stacking needs at least two queries.
analysis.about.centrality.pageRank: Scores each node by how many edges lead to it and how important their origin is. Good for “Who is central here?”.
analysis.about.centrality.betweenness: How often a node lies on shortest paths between others. Finds brokers and bottlenecks.
analysis.about.centrality.closeness: How close a node is to all others it reaches. Finds nodes from which everything is quick to reach.
analysis.about.centrality.eigenvector: Important is who is connected to important nodes. Like PageRank, without damping.
analysis.about.centrality.harmonic: Like closeness, but also works in graphs that fall into parts.
analysis.about.communities.louvain: Splits the graph into groups that are densely connected inside and loosely to the outside.
analysis.about.communities.leiden: Like Louvain, with groups that are always connected within.
analysis.about.communities.labelPropagat: Quick groups: each node takes the most common group of its neighbours.
analysis.about.communities.weaklyConnect: Which parts are connected at all, regardless of edge direction?
analysis.about.communities.stronglyConne: Parts in which every node reaches every other along the arrows.
analysis.about.kCore: The dense core: nodes with at least k neighbours in the core.
analysis.about.triangles: How many triangles a node closes and how closely its neighbours are connected to each other.
analysis.about.similarity.jaccard: Similar nodes by shared neighbours: customers who buy the same things.
analysis.about.similarity.overlap: Like Jaccard, but measured against the smaller of the two: finds subsets.
analysis.about.similarity.cosine: Similar nodes by their number properties, such as revenue and age.
analysis.about.similarity.knn: Links each node to the k most similar by its number properties.
analysis.about.paths.shortest: The path with the fewest edges between two nodes.
analysis.about.paths.allShortest: All equally short paths between two nodes, up to a maximum count.
analysis.about.paths.weighted: The path with the least sum of a number on the edges, such as cost or duration.
analysis.about.paths.kShortest: The k best paths between two nodes, the second and third best too.
analysis.about.reachable: What a node reaches within at most n edges, with the distance per node.
analysis.about.bridges: Edges without which the graph falls apart.
analysis.about.articulationPoints: Nodes without which the graph falls apart.
analysis.about.cycles: Cycles in the graph, listed up to a maximum length and count.
analysis.about.linkPrediction.commonNeig: Suggests edges between nodes that share many neighbours. Only a suggestion, no data.
analysis.about.linkPrediction.adamicAdar: Like common neighbours, rare neighbours count more. Only a suggestion, no data.
analysis.about.linkPrediction.preferenti: Suggests edges between well connected nodes. Only a suggestion, no data.
analysis.about.mergeNodes: Turns many nodes into one per label, per value or per community, with counts and sums.
analysis.about.aggregateAlong: Computes over neighbours or paths: sum, mean, count along the edges.
analysis.where.libraryOrServer: Computes in {engine} ({library}) when the library is installed, else on the Kalzit server. Always on the query’s result, never on the whole database.
analysis.where.serverAlgo: Computes on the Kalzit server, on the query’s result.
analysis.algo.varies: The result may differ slightly between runs. The number of groups and the values stay close; single nodes at the edge may switch.
analysis.algo.limitAdmin: A server admin sets the limit: Settings › Data sources › Graph steps.
analysis.algo.label: Only nodes with the label
analysis.algo.fields.centrality.pageRank: Stays a graph; every node gets pagerank, summing to 1.
analysis.algo.fields.centrality.betweenn: Stays a graph; every node gets betweenness. Costly: computes up to a fifth of the node limit.
analysis.algo.fields.centrality.closenes: Stays a graph; every node gets closeness, 0 to 1. Costly.
analysis.algo.fields.centrality.eigenvec: Stays a graph; every node gets eigenvector.
analysis.algo.fields.centrality.harmonic: Stays a graph; every node gets harmonic, 0 to 1. Costly.
analysis.algo.fields.communities: Stays a graph; every node gets the number of its community. The number is a name, not a rank. Holds for this part of the data, not the whole database.
analysis.algo.fields.components: Stays a graph; every node gets the number of its component.
analysis.algo.fields.kCore: Stays a graph; every node gets its core number. With k only the nodes of core number k or more stay.
analysis.algo.fields.triangles: Stays a graph; every node gets triangles and clustering (0 to 1).
analysis.algo.fields.similarTable: Becomes a table: a, b, score, aId, bId.
analysis.algo.fields.similarEdges: Stays a graph; new edges with score link similar nodes.
analysis.algo.fields.linkPrediction: Stays a graph; suggested edges are dotted, are not counted and go into no later step. Topology only, no trained model.
analysis.algo.keepAll: Keep the rest of the graph
analysis.algo.sameEnds: From and To must be two different nodes.
analysis.algo.fields.paths: Stays a graph of the paths; every node on them gets path_order. With “Keep the rest of the graph” everything stays and the paths are listed.
analysis.algo.fields.reachable: Stays a graph of what was reached; every node gets distance.
analysis.algo.fields.bridges: Stays a graph; every edge gets bridge (yes or no).
analysis.algo.fields.articulationPoints: Stays a graph; every node gets articulation (yes or no).
analysis.algo.fields.cycles: Stays a graph; the cycles are listed, every node gets in_cycle. Cycles grow fast with length; when the maximum is reached, the sentence says so.
analysis.algo.mergeBy.label: Label
analysis.algo.loops: Keep edges within a group as a loop
analysis.algo.fields.mergeNodes: Changes the result: afterwards there are only the group nodes; later steps, rules and alerts use them. To expand them, turn the step off.
analysis.algo.fields.alongNeighbours: Stays a graph; every node with the label gets the value over the neighbours reached, each once. Only nodes in the query’s result count.
analysis.algo.fields.alongPaths: Stays a graph; every path gets the value over its nodes or edges.
